## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `npm ci` and `npm run check` successfully.
- [ ] I reviewed the rendered README, including navigation and tables.
- [ ] New or changed project links point to the intended repositories or deployments.
- [ ] Images have useful alternative text and external services have a fallback or explanation.
- [ ] Skills, project descriptions and learning claims are accurate and supported.
- [ ] Certifications are not described as completed unless awarded.
- [ ] No credentials, personal access tokens or private information were added.

## Notes for review

Call out unavailable deployments, claims that need the profile owner's confirmation, or follow-up work.
